"""Run target created suspended; alternate short resume bursts with suspend+snapshot,
stretching the entire (ms-scale) lifetime into seconds.

Usage: python burst.py <dir> <tag> <stdin-escaped> [bursts] [resume_ms]
Writes <dir>/<tag>.bN / .idx.json
"""
import sys, ctypes, ctypes.wintypes as wt, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"<G5A_WORKDIR>").resolve()

def safe(p) -> Path:
    rp = Path(p).resolve()
    if rp != ROOT and ROOT not in rp.parents:
        raise ValueError("outside ROOT")
    return rp

k32 = ctypes.WinDLL('kernel32', use_last_error=True)
PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS = 0x1F0FFF
TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD = 0x4
CREATE_SUSPENDED = 0x4

class THREADENTRY32(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('dwSize', wt.DWORD), ('cntUsage', wt.DWORD), ('th32ThreadID', wt.DWORD),
                ('th32OwnerProcessID', wt.DWORD), ('tpBasePri', ctypes.c_long), ('tpDeltaPri', ctypes.c_long), ('dwFlags', wt.DWORD)]

def threads_of(pid):
    snap = k32.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD, 0)
    te = THREADENTRY32(); te.dwSize = ctypes.sizeof(te)
    out = []
    ok = k32.Thread32First(snap, ctypes.byref(te))
    while ok:
        if te.th32OwnerProcessID == pid:
            out.append(te.th32ThreadID)
        ok = k32.Thread32Next(snap, ctypes.byref(te))
    k32.CloseHandle(snap)
    return out

def suspend_all(pid):
    for tid in threads_of(pid):
        th = k32.OpenThread(0x1FFFFF, False, tid)
        if th:
            k32.SuspendThread(th); k32.CloseHandle(th)

def resume_all(pid):
    for tid in threads_of(pid):
        th = k32.OpenThread(0x1FFFFF, False, tid)
        if th:
            while k32.ResumeThread(th) > 0:
                pass
            k32.CloseHandle(th)

def main():
    wdir = safe(sys.argv[1])
    tag = sys.argv[2]
    stdin_bytes = sys.argv[3].encode().decode('unicode_escape').encode('latin1') if len(sys.argv) > 3 else b'hello\n'
    bursts = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 30
    resume_ms = int(sys.argv[5]) if len(sys.argv) > 5 else 20
    p = subprocess.Popen([str(wdir / 'app.exe')], cwd=str(wdir), creationflags=CREATE_SUSPENDED,
                         stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    p.stdin.write(stdin_bytes)
    p.stdin.close()
    t0 = time.time()
    fed_eof = True
    for i in range(bursts):
        resume_all(p.pid)
        time.sleep(resume_ms / 1000.0)
        suspend_all(p.pid)
        if p.poll() is not None:
            print(f'[{time.time()-t0:6.2f}s] burst {i}: exited rc={p.returncode}')
            break
        out = wdir / f'{tag}.b{i}'
        r = subprocess.run(['<PY312>', str(ROOT / '_work' / 'memdump_nokill.py'), str(p.pid), str(out)],
                           capture_output=True, text=True)
        print(f'[{time.time()-t0:6.2f}s] burst {i}: {r.stdout.strip()} {r.stderr.strip()}', flush=True)
    if p.poll() is None:
        resume_all(p.pid)
    try:
        o, e = p.communicate(timeout=20)
        print(f'final rc={p.returncode} out={o!r}')
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        p.kill()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
